title: S3 assembly result
$comment: Draft v0 (T-014 P2). The S3 stage result around knowledge_pack.v0 (docs/stages/S3-knowledge.md). retrieval_state uses the response retrieval-state enum minus disabled, because S3 is absent with retrieval off: skipped_no_knowledge_needed (the plan lists no needed facet), no_match (needs exist but no fact or image passed the filters), retrieved (at least one fact or image), failed (no pinned snapshot or a pinned-table read failed). pack is null exactly when the state is failed, and error is non-null exactly then; code checks the pairing and the pack invariants after this schema.
